005package com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
008
009import org.littletonrobotics.junction.AutoLog;
010
011public interface ModuleIO {
012    @AutoLog
013    public static class ModuleIOInputs {
014        public boolean driveConnected = false;
015        public double drivePositionRad = 0.0;
016        public double driveVelocityRadPerSec = 0.0;
017        public double driveAppliedVolts = 0.0;
018        public double driveCurrentAmps = 0.0;
019
020        public boolean turnConnected = false;
021        public boolean turnEncoderConnected = false;
022        public Rotation2d turnAbsolutePosition = Rotation2d.ZERO;
023        public Rotation2d turnPosition = Rotation2d.ZERO;
024        public double turnVelocityRadPerSec = 0.0;
025        public double turnAppliedVolts = 0.0;
026        public double turnCurrentAmps = 0.0;
027
028        public double[] odometryTimestamps = new double[] {};
029        public double[] odometryDrivePositionsRad = new double[] {};
030        public Rotation2d[] odometryTurnPositions = new Rotation2d[] {};
031    }
032
033    /** Updates the set of loggable inputs. */
034    public default void updateInputs(ModuleIOInputs inputs) {}
035
036    /** Run the drive motor at the specified open loop value. */
037    public default void setDriveOpenLoop(double output) {}
038
039    /** Run the turn motor at the specified open loop value. */
040    public default void setTurnOpenLoop(double output) {}
041
042    /** Run the drive motor at the specified velocity. */
043    public default void setDriveVelocity(double velocityRadPerSec) {}
044
045    /** Run the turn motor to the specified rotation. */
046    public default void setTurnPosition(Rotation2d rotation) {}
047}
